summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM). At the AGM, shareholders re-elected all seven current directors and approved the reappointment of UHY LLP as auditor. The company also reiterated its capital allocation policy targeting at least $100 million annual shareholder returns, building on a November 2025 buyback authorization. This is a routine AGM disclosure with no strategic corporate action such as a merger, acquisition, spin-off, or tender offer. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of shareholder meeting outcomes.
